title: PicardFixedModelResidueChainComparison
statement: Let f:X→S and fi:Xi→S, i in Fin n, be flat proper locally finitely presented, and ui:Xi→X over S. Assume the structure adjunction units of f are universally isomorphisms, L is invertible, k:W→S is an immersion, w∈U⊂W with U affine and s=k(w), and L_s descends from a finite locally free module on Spec kappa(s). Supply trivializations of each ui^*L over Xi×S U. Supply a strictly perfect connective source complex K representing R(f_W)_*L_W on U, term ranks equal to every residue Betti number, and section bases e0:Gamma(K^0)≃A and e1:Gamma(K^1)≃A^m. For each i supply a strictly perfect connective target complex C_i representing R(fi_W)_*(ui^*L)_W on U with zero degree-zero differential. For p=ker(A→kappa(w)), there exist an additive equivalence alpha:kappa(p)⊗A^m≃H^1(X_s,O), an A-linear section map t:A^m→product_i Gamma(C_i^1), and an additive map gamma:kappa(p)⊗product_i Gamma(C_i^1)→product_i H^1(Xi_s,O), satisfying t(e1(d_K(e0 inverse(a))))=0 for all a and gamma(t⊗kappa(p))(z)=(ui_s^*(alpha(z)))_i. No free ambient target or joint map b is asserted. All notions are those of [def-pc-perfect-complex], [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti], [def-sc-invertible-module], [def-sc-structure-sheaf-cohomology-pullback], [def-pc-derived-direct-image], [def-pc-module-pullback], and [def-weil-residue-field].

source.place: Tag 0BF2, proof before the joint H-one injectivity argument; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BF2

proof.text: Obtain compatible derived arrows, source residue equivalence, and joint residue comparison from the derived comparison lemma.

Represent each derived arrow by a chain map using perfect_affine_map_representative and choose that representative, whose localization is specified. Evaluate its degree-one component on sections and compose with e1 inverse, then take their product t. Apply the derived comparison to these representatives to obtain the required gamma equation.

For each i the chain equation gives d_K(0,1) composed with phi_i(1) equal to phi_i(0) composed with d_Ci(0,1), which is zero by hCzero. Evaluate on e0 inverse(a) and cancel e1 inverse composed with e1. Coordinate extensionality gives t(e1(d_K(e0 inverse(a))))=0. Assemble the witnesses and both equations.
